description: Controllers monitor pressures, flows, gas quality, and alarms and operate 62 remote valves, receipt and delivery points, and 5 compressor stations through SCADA, 24x7
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public safety (overpressure or an undetected rupture); firm deliveries to 9 LDCs serving about 1.3 million customers and 7 power plants; manual operation of 780 miles needs crews at the 5 compressor stations, 4 receipt points, and the 20 largest M&R stations and holds safely for about one 8-hour shift
manual_workaround: Fail over to the Backup Control Center (hot standby, target 1 hour); otherwise operate manually under the manual operation plan (192.631(c)(3)) with field crews at key sites, by radio and phone
dependent_third_parties: SCADA software vendor; telecom carrier; upstream interstate pipelines
dependent_people_or_facilities: 28 gas controllers and 5 shift supervisors; SCADA and OT engineering; field crews; GCC and BCC
quantified_operational_impact: About 1.0 million dekatherms per day scheduled; manual operation needs about 180 field staff on overtime per shift
quantified_regulatory_impact: Part 191 incident if a shutdown is judged significant; 192.631 duties continue in manual operation
public_safety_impact: Severe: overpressure or delayed rupture detection; loss of supply to homes in cold weather if deliveries are curtailed

description: Run 14 compressor units at 5 stations to hold delivery pressures; station PLCs and unit control panels run locally and report to SCADA
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without compression, Florida delivery pressures drop below contract minimums within about 12 hours on high-demand days; station ESD systems are hardwired and independent of SCADA
manual_workaround: Local operation from each station control room by compressor station technicians; units can be started and loaded from the unit control panels
dependent_third_parties: Compressor OEM (remote diagnostics and service); controls integrator
dependent_people_or_facilities: 64 compressor station technicians; 5 Compressor Station Supervisors
quantified_operational_impact: Up to about 40% of capacity at risk on peak days if more than 2 stations are lost
quantified_regulatory_impact: Pressure limits under the O&M manual (192.605)
public_safety_impact: Severe: pressure excursions if station control is manipulated; Moderate otherwise

business_process: Emergency response and public safety communication
description: Receive and classify emergency notices, dispatch field crews, notify 9-1-1 centers and officials, and make incident notices (192.615; 49 CFR Part 191)
process_owner: Director of Pipeline Safety and Compliance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Emergency response cannot pause: 49 CFR 191.5 requires notice no later than one hour after confirmed discovery of an incident; 192.615 requires communication with public safety answering points
manual_workaround: Printed contact lists at the GCC, BCC, and every area office; satellite phones at the GCC and BCC; radio; personal cell phones
dependent_third_parties: Public safety answering points; county emergency managers in 3 states; National Response Center; PHMSA
dependent_people_or_facilities: On-call supervisors; Director of Pipeline Safety and Compliance
quantified_operational_impact: Response to about 30 third-party damage and odor calls a year; one-call tickets continue by phone

business_process: Contract operation of two third-party laterals (operations services agreements)
description: Monitor and control the municipal utility lateral (60 miles) and the power generator lateral (35 miles) from the GCC
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: OSAs require notice to each lateral owner within 30 minutes of losing SCADA monitoring and pay service credits after 4 hours; the owners must otherwise staff their laterals with their own field crews
manual_workaround: Notify both owners within 30 minutes; owners dispatch their field staff; GCC supports by phone from the BCC
quantified_operational_impact: 2 customers; 95 miles of pipeline not owned by the company
quantified_regulatory_impact: Lateral owners keep their own Part 191 and 192.631 duties; contract notice and credits
public_safety_impact: Severe if neither the company nor the owner monitors the laterals

description: Receive shipper nominations on the customer activities website, confirm with upstream and downstream operators, and schedule each NAESB nomination cycle
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: NAESB timely and intraday nomination cycles each gas day; missed cycles cause imbalances and scheduling errors for 44 shippers; power plants nominate intraday
manual_workaround: Phone and email nominations entered into a spreadsheet; confirmations by phone with each interconnecting operator
dependent_third_parties: Customer activities website vendor; interconnecting pipelines
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,400 nominations per gas day across 5 cycles
quantified_regulatory_impact: Tariff and NAESB WGQ business practices (18 CFR 284.12)
public_safety_impact: Minimal directly; Moderate if a power plant is short of gas at peak

business_process: Gas measurement and custody transfer data
description: Collect hourly and daily volumes and gas quality from flow computers and chromatographs; validate for allocations, imbalances, and invoices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Flow computers keep about 35 days of data locally, so field data is not lost; the measurement application in the cloud is needed to validate and allocate volumes
manual_workaround: Download flow computer archives on site; estimate from SCADA historian totals
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-01 historian; SYS-11 measurement application
quantified_regulatory_impact: Measurement data must be available for allocation under the tariff

description: Anomaly model scores historian data and alerts controllers to possible leaks (P10 AI-001)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Advisory only; SCADA pressure and rate-of-change alarms, patrols (192.705), and leakage surveys (192.706) remain the required methods; loss reduces early warning
manual_workaround: Controllers rely on SCADA alarms and line-pack trending
dependent_systems: SYS-11 OT analytics account; SYS-06 historian replica
quantified_operational_impact: Model scores 62 pipeline segments every minute
quantified_regulatory_impact: Rupture identification procedures name the model as a supporting source (192.615(a)(12))
public_safety_impact: Moderate: slower detection of small leaks

business_process: Informational Postings, critical notices, and capacity release
description: Post capacity, scheduled quantities, outages, and critical notices on the customer activities website and process capacity release transactions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FERC requires equal and timely posting of capacity information and all planned and actual service outages or reductions (18 CFR 284.13(d)(1)); shippers need critical notices before curtailment
manual_workaround: Email and phone notices to all shippers from the printed shipper contact list; post on the website when it returns
quantified_regulatory_impact: 18 CFR 284.13 posting duties; NAESB WGQ standards (18 CFR 284.12)

description: Monthly transportation invoices, imbalance statements, reservation charge credits, and revenue accounting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly billing cycle; about $8.3 million billed each month; invoices can be issued late without service impact. A billing outage alone never justifies shutting down the pipeline
manual_workaround: Issue estimated invoices from the prior month and true up later

business_process: Field O&M, integrity management, and compliance records
description: Work orders, patrols, leakage surveys, cathodic protection, one-call tickets, operator qualification records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Compliance records must be available for PHMSA inspection; crews need maps and work orders for emergencies (printed maps are kept in trucks)
manual_workaround: Printed maps and paper work orders; one-call tickets by phone
dependent_third_parties: Work management SaaS vendor (part of SYS-13)
public_safety_impact: Moderate if patrols or one-call responses lapse

description: Pipeline maps, alignment sheets, integrity data, and MAOP records used for emergency response and planning
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Emergency responders need current maps within hours; printed map books exist but lag GIS by up to a quarter
manual_workaround: Printed map books at the GCC, BCC, and area offices; offline map copies on field tablets
quantified_regulatory_impact: Integrity and MAOP records retained under Part 192

description: Badge access, CCTV, and intrusion alarms at the GCC, BCC, compressor stations, and M&R stations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Physical access control for control rooms is part of the TSA plan (CCS-1, CCS-2) and a compensating control for HMI authentication
manual_workaround: Guards or staff posted at the GCC and BCC doors; manual sign-in logs; locks at stations
quantified_regulatory_impact: SD 02G III.C.2 compensating controls for HMI access

business_process: Cybersecurity monitoring, incident response, and TSA coordination
description: MSSP monitoring, SIEM and OT sensor alerts, Cybersecurity Coordinator duties, incident reporting to CISA
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: TSA requires the Cybersecurity Coordinator to be reachable 24x7 and incidents reported to CISA within 72 hours; recovery cannot be validated without monitoring
manual_workaround: MSSP works from its own platform; Coordinator reachable by personal phone; manual log exports
dependent_people_or_facilities: Security Manager; OT Security Engineers; analysts
quantified_operational_impact: About 2,500 alerts a month triaged by the MSSP
public_safety_impact: Moderate: an OT attack could go unseen

business_process: Supply chain, warehouse, and spare parts
description: Purchasing, warehouse, and spare parts for compressor and SCADA equipment
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Spare parts are held at 2 warehouses; urgent parts can be bought by phone and card from approved suppliers

business_process: Payroll, HR, and finance (treasury and payables)
description: Biweekly payroll, onboarding and terminations, accounts payable, treasury
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; missing payroll has legal and retention impact; terminations feed account removal
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider; manual termination notices to IT and OT administrators
